ExampleSentence: I have a blue pencil in my schoolbag.
ExampleTranslation: 我的书包里有一支蓝色铅笔。

ExampleSentence: Our teacher is reading an English book.
ExampleTranslation: 我们的老师正在读一本英语书。

ExampleSentence: My face is red after PE class.
ExampleTranslation: 体育课后我的脸红了。

ExampleSentence: My nose is cold in winter.
ExampleTranslation: 冬天我的鼻子很冷。

ExampleSentence: Please open your mouth.
ExampleTranslation: 请张开嘴。

ExampleSentence: My sister and I go to school by bus.
ExampleTranslation: 我和妹妹坐公交车上学。

ExampleSentence: My first class is at eight.
ExampleTranslation: 我的第一节课八点开始。

ExampleSentence: I have milk for breakfast every morning.
ExampleTranslation: 我每天早饭都喝牛奶。

ExampleSentence: My sister wore a yellow dress to the party.
ExampleTranslation: 我妹妹穿着一条黄色连衣裙去参加聚会。

ExampleSentence: We make snowmen in winter with our friends.
ExampleTranslation: 冬天我们和朋友们一起堆雪人。

ExampleSentence: There are fourteen books on the desk.
ExampleTranslation: 桌子上有十四本书。

ExampleSentence: We play football during playtime.
ExampleTranslation: 游戏时间我们踢足球。

ExampleSentence: We have PE class on Friday afternoon.
ExampleTranslation: 我们星期五下午有体育课。

ExampleSentence: I have English homework to do today.
ExampleTranslation: 我今天有英语作业要做。

ExampleSentence: Too much ice-cream is bad for your teeth.
ExampleTranslation: 吃太多冰淇淋对牙齿不好。

ExampleSentence: This is a short summary of our class.
ExampleTranslation: 这是我们课堂内容的简短总结。

ExampleSentence: I put a tomato in my lunch box.
ExampleTranslation: 我在午餐盒里放了一个西红柿。

ExampleSentence: Milk and eggs are on my shopping list.
ExampleTranslation: 牛奶和鸡蛋在我的购物清单上。

ExampleSentence: My sister likes to dance to music.
ExampleTranslation: 我妹妹喜欢跟着音乐跳舞。

ExampleSentence: I listen to music after school every day.
ExampleTranslation: 我每天放学后听音乐。

ExampleSentence: I draw pictures after school with my friends.
ExampleTranslation: 我放学后和朋友们一起画画。

ExampleSentence: My family often has dinner at home.
ExampleTranslation: 我们一家经常在家吃晚饭。

ExampleSentence: My bedroom has a bed and a desk.
ExampleTranslation: 我的卧室里有一张床和一张书桌。
